Name: Recon Drone
Payload_or_Uses: Spots enemies within 120 m for 30 s
Counterplay_or_Notes: Can be countered by concealment or electronic warfare: thermal cloaks and EMP hide you from it

Name: Supply Drop
Payload_or_Uses: One crate: full ammo, grenades and 100 HP for everyone within 8 m, 3 uses

Name: Combat Drone
Payload_or_Uses: AI attack drone for 45 s (WIR helicopter network)
Counterplay_or_Notes: Vulnerable to anti-air and electronic warfare

Name: Artillery Strike
Payload_or_Uses: 10 shells in 25 m over 6 s after a 3 s warning
Counterplay_or_Notes: Warning and counterplay recommended: a red ring marks the area for 3 s

Name: Attack Helicopter
Counterplay_or_Notes: Can be engaged by anti-air systems

Name: Tactical Airstrike
Payload_or_Uses: 4 guided bombs along a 60 m line
Counterplay_or_Notes: Requires target designation: the line must be in the caller's sight

Name: Hunter Protocol
Effect: Attempts to neutralize up to 16 targets in a designated field; proposed 80% per-target success
Payload_or_Uses: 16 seeker bolts into a 60 m field after 2 s; each neutralizes its target with 80% chance
Counterplay_or_Notes: Targets under a roof, in smoke or in a thermal cloak halve the chance; AA vehicles within 150 m shoot down 1 bolt per second

Name: Mine Kit
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard
Payload_or_Uses: 16 mines (12 anti-personnel, 4 anti-vehicle) in an arc, line or ring
Counterplay_or_Notes: Mines are seen within 6 m and disarmed with a Repair Tool; they expire after 300 s

Name: Emergency Ammunition
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard
Payload_or_Uses: Full ammo, launchers and grenades, now

Name: Reinforcement Squad
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard
Effect: Deploys an AI infantry reinforcement squad
Payload_or_Uses: 8 soldiers (proposed) who follow your calls for 120 s
Counterplay_or_Notes: May exceed the team cap by 8; one per team at a time

Name: Field Repair Kit
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard
Payload_or_Uses: 1500 HP to the vehicle you are in or next to, over 8 s

Name: Portable Turret
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard
Counterplay_or_Notes: Fires only at what it can see; explosives kill it fast

Name: Anti-Armor Kit
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard

Name: Emergency Recon
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard
Payload_or_Uses: Every enemy within 220 m shown for 20 s
Counterplay_or_Notes: Thermal cloaks hide you from it

Name: EMP Charge
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard
Payload_or_Uses: 30 m pulse: vehicles stall, drones fall, optics and minimaps go dark for 8 s

Name: Emergency Extraction
Proposed_Requirement: 150 s in the bottom 25% of the team leaderboard
Effect: Calls a transport vehicle to a designated pickup point
Payload_or_Uses: An AI transport helicopter lands at the point, waits 15 s, flies to your nearest territory
Counterplay_or_Notes: The landing zone must be open; it waves off under heavy AA
